context.reference: Complete seasons detrended over 2001–2025; pre-2001 sensor records are provisional. Current observations use the same elapsed window in previous seasons and need ten reference years.
context.weighting: CROPGRIDS v1.08 crop harvested area; at least 90% spatial crop coverage, 50% valid weight each week, and 80% elapsed-day coverage.
context.limitation: Observation supplement only. No additional ENSO response, expected NDVI anomaly or forecast skill is fitted.
